values.summary: Bootstrap #492 after #491 terminal ancestry, approve a design centered on the GCP organization/billing denominator, bind a FastWork worktree, implement Terraform/docs/evidence/readback surfaces, run focused proof, obtain exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

steps.action: Bootstrap and approve the GCP-C organization/billing baseline design from current main containing #491.
Bind the #492 FastWork execution worktree and preserve dependency/collision truth.
Implement organization/billing Terraform, operator runbook, redacted readback/evidence packets, and issue-owned validation scripts.
Validate, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

invariants: New managed projects have corporate group ownership, not individual-only ownership
Every admitted project has cost-attribution labels and billing observability
Organization policies remain scoped to the reviewed denominator
Existing POC resources are unchanged unless a reviewed exception is explicit
Terraform bootstrap ownership remains #491 and is consumed read-only
Evidence is redacted and never includes credential material
risks: A broad organization policy could affect unrelated POC resources
Individual-only ownership can leave the baseline non-corporate
Billing export or budget absence can hide spend
Live GCP state can drift between readback and review
Credential or account details can leak if evidence is not redacted
stop_conditions: A broad policy could affect POC resources
Live GCP readback would require unavailable credentials or credential exposure
A proposed change would implement #493, #494, #495, or production activation scope
